title: The card consolidation stops where merging becomes redesign

owner_note.text: Of the plan's 13 merges, 8 are landed (pop-ups, folds, frames, AI rows, AI cards and the first three). The rest were measured and left: the library sections, the doc well, the tab panes and the page surface each change the look beyond the box style (a title moving 36 px, a band splitting in two colours), and the AI pills wait on your pill-button call. The alternative is to treat those four as a redesign you approve page by page; say so and they get briefed that way.
